Royal application, interview, handover, emperor order, player cooking, six-second fictional story preparation, delivery and at-least-twelve-second original consumption must all occur in the resumed production main.

journal.staging: Explicit historical ordinary tea-service and adult conversation events produced through public writers using original seeded personalities. Two ordinary supporters are committed; a third ordinary support completion awaits persistence. Calendar alone starts at 13:00 after those histories, not natural multi-day play. Legacy known-China entry is declared; travel remains enabled. No political response, route, court completion, preparation, appointment, sovereign office, money or actor position is seeded.
